newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Telecom shares up on warrant talk.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom shares up on warrant talk.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd shares edged up on Wednesday on talk of a covered warrant issue on the stock, brokers said.
"Talk of a covered warrant issue on the stock fuelled demand for the shares, especially since the stock is lagging behind the market," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Hongkong Telecom shares were up HK$0.10 to HK$12.30 at midday on volume of 4.51 million shares worth HK$55.49 million.
Brokers said there was talk of an issue of about 300 million warrants carrying a premium of 10.2 percent and gearing of 6.58 times.
